files.README.md:
# Sonarr operations
Bind the primary Sonarr integration and optionally a second one. Existing Homarr native query and interaction permissions apply. Each result retains its connection identity, including when different servers use the same numeric episode ID.

Compact view shows four episodes; advanced view includes all loaded rows, source selection and text filtering. The reference reads up to 100 missing and queued episodes per server. A failure on one server does not hide the other server's result.

Search episode is a named modify action. It confirms the target server and episode before submitting the native Sonarr EpisodeSearch command. A queued command does not prove a release was found or downloaded. Default previews simulate actions. The integration sends the API key server-side; no key is embedded in portable source.

API reference: https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/develop/src/NzbDrone.Core/IndexerSearch/EpisodeSearchCommand.cs and https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/develop/src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Commands/CommandController.cs
